_note: Belfius Banque & Assurances' socio-economic typology of Belgian municipalities, resolved onto today's communes by scripts/export_commune_typology.py from config/geography/belfius_clusters.csv (the composition, name for name as printed) and belfius_clusters.yaml (labels). A classification, not a figure. A commune merged from parts that sat in different clusters is `mixed` and assigned to none.
